name: terminal-animation
blurb: Terminal with tabs shows commands typing and output revealing line-by-line.
description: Tabs trigger animation: command types character-by-character, output lines appear in sequence with delays. Optionally slides up on scroll into view. Uses React Context to coordinate child components.
use_when: Hero sections or docs demonstrating CLI workflows with interactive tab switching.
avoid_when: When animation must pause/resume or loop indefinitely; animation runs once per tab on mount.
a11y: Output has aria-live='polite' for screen readers. No prefers-reduced-motion handling. Tab list has role='tablist'.
